claims.statement: Frank Rush was shot in front of Allen's saloon at 621 Market Street at about 1 a.m. on 22 December 1884 by an unknown man who escaped.
claims.excerpt: shot in front of Tom Allen’s saloon at 621 Market street by an unknown man

claims.statement: Free and easy concerts were given at Allen's saloon.
claims.excerpt: Free and easy concerts are given — at Allen's place.

claims.statement: Frank Rush, a coal miner, lodged over Allen's saloon and was one of its regular attaches.
claims.excerpt: Among those attaches of the place 1s Frank Rush, a coal miner, who lodges over the saloon

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: He was so drunk he couldn't light his cigar and Rush hit him a tip.
quotes.topic: his account of the stranger in the shooting

notes: Shooting account; Allen's version is the quote. The shooter and Rush's own statement are not Allen's and are left out.
